### 1. Use ChatGPT directly inside Microsoft Word

- **Install the Add-in:** Get the official add-in from the Microsoft Marketplace.
- **Open in Word:** Launch Microsoft Word, open the ChatGPT sidebar from the ribbon, and sign in with your OpenAI account.
- **Draft and Edit:** Ask ChatGPT to draft sections, turn rough notes into documents, or revise highlighted text directly inside your Word document.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXN-AU2VYyI-wuXKwOeEyqe4ZZfNIlxUnsa9VQFY8nbF4XLE0pALi8CKt4IN95CVPg3uudZ7N4zwsgxB2OAYFGnKtDpCsVGkA4JyBIoE3to85rxHtNPvUMCesjOfWIXGsxVXawrz-UqVnLEImXlRSp-OyRWZny)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESWwHEIkXXI8Agd7Wyo04-Xx-ssKHnlnF0sk_izlW-ZCp7aL6SJPseISJet_XU80a2NtYMe8np6xwp9xdD5VjeYCg2MFRiy5yazx5z2CN8OV2O37_yajdyQRlMsoo)

### 2. Export ChatGPT Conversations to Word

- **Chrome Extensions:** Install the [ChatGPT to Word or PDF Chrome Extension](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/chatgpt-to-word-or-pdf/mjdmggegbkookpcmbdllcnbfboikcbop?hl=en) to save single responses or entire chats with a single click while preserving tables, code blocks, and math equations.[[1]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/chatgpt-to-word-or-pdf/mjdmggegbkookpcmbdllcnbfboikcbop)
- **Online Converters:** Copy your ChatGPT response or markdown and paste it into a free markdown-to-Word converter like [MD2Doc](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESUAHEIkXXJ7ZsPrAQTJSe-D3E8QtqvUO8MUD2MwCAACmpauLejKREghYfuqSgMt6nLDEP6zfy_MK3Y3tenK2yd3lWb3i8wdPeoOQRuLOHBIMD) to download an editable `.docx` file.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESUAHEIkXXJ7ZsPrAQTJSe-D3E8QtqvUO8MUD2MwCAACmpauLejKREghYfuqSgMt6nLDEP6zfy_MK3Y3tenK2yd3lWb3i8wdPeoOQRuLOHBIMD)
- **Copy and Paste:** For basic text, highlight the response in ChatGPT, copy it (`Ctrl + C` / `Cmd + C` ), and paste it directly into a blank Word document.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF16HQGM0R6WixLSn1-WOfSAA9ht2rGwhctM8Ir1Qwhfg47w-MfV58P6rlsuWWmrAH0Y5FGzDMKYs81Q-X_YmN-fpMeUze48iev4mIRJvOO5hP4NVQnT8jhAKVNspsex4AexkMVxNKmLXEYr6EUYsi88huogPwhPz982mfbVoEbiEo)
